title: Carb loading for a half marathon

entries.query_str: carb loading for a half marathon on thursday, im ~66kg. how many grams per kg and starting when. goal ~1:25
entries.answer:
For a half marathon (~85 minutes at your goal), a **full multi-day carb load isn't necessary**, but topping off glycogen helps [1][2]:
- **24–36 hours before**: about **7–10 g carbohydrate per kg** per day → roughly **460–660 g/day** at 66 kg. Shift toward lower-fiber sources (white rice, bread, pasta, potatoes, juice) so it sits well.
- **Race morning (2–3 h before)**: **1–2 g/kg** → ~70–135 g (e.g., bagel + banana + honey) [2].
- **During**: for ~85 minutes, one gel around 35–45 minutes is optional; many runners at that duration take one gel for a late boost [1].

Practice the race-morning breakfast before a long run this weekend, not for the first time on race day [2].

entries.query_str: thursday morning race, so wed is the main day?
entries.answer: Yes — make **Wednesday** the high-carb day (~7–10 g/kg), and keep Tuesday normal-to-slightly-higher. Eat your last big meal Wednesday early evening so it's digested, then the planned breakfast Thursday 2–3 hours before the start [1].
